reviewMethod: Read-only source, original review, poster and supplied diagnostic Blender-render inspection. No browser, independent runtime execution or video playback. Only final-review.json files written. Integrated UI verification belongs to coordinator.
gateStandard: Require useful spatial inspection beyond the existing video, not impossibility of representing the lesson in 2D.
spatialBenefitAssessment: The rebuild is a clearer, reversible two-route counterfactual, but still an extruded route diagram. Both rods travel in one horizontal plane; changing check placement changes graph reachability. Orbit helps read small contacts or see around the collar, but reveals no additional explanatory relationship. Added bypass content is useful beyond the existing video; the spatial implementation does not earn a separate 3D investigation.
rationale: The author implemented the original suggested salvage faithfully: open vault, two routes, movable check, returned artifacts and stale results. The final result nevertheless centers on where authorization runs, substantially overlapping guardrails-and-permissions. Harness coverage is fixed at four probes; the narrower harness is only a caption counterfactual. Recommend omitting this 3D asset and retaining the coverage example in a compact interactive 2D illustration or guide. This verdict does not require a lesson to be impossible in 2D: here depth contributes presentation and occlusion rather than useful investigation.

findings.issue: The new interaction chiefly teaches enforcement placement rather than harness coverage, and its explanatory structure remains planar.
findings.evidence: build_scene.py uses RZ=0.62 for all probes; interaction.js changes front versus guard placement while PROBES always contains the same four cases. Guardrails intent describes the same alternate-route/check-placement relationship and recommends omission.
findings.requestedChange: Omit this candidate from the spatial offering; preserve the useful bypass/coverage example outside 3D.

findings.issue: Allowed probes jump immediately to full reach instead of extending along the corridor.
findings.evidence: In pose(t), dist starts as min(o.stop, reach), but every unblocked probe overwrites it with o.stop + (D0 - o.stop) * back. Before 1.9 seconds back is zero, so dist is already 2.68 on the first update.
findings.requestedChange: If retained elsewhere, apply retraction only after the extension/hold phase. Verify intermediate animation states, not just final results.

findings.issue: Depth adds visibility costs: the collar masks the tray and station identifiers are poorly exposed in the poster.
findings.evidence: poster.png and captures/blender-h-guard.png; revision.json also records collar occlusion and soft 420px letters. Returned copies and persistent blocked contacts are real improvements, but their small geometry still needs UI verification.
findings.requestedChange: Do not treat poster or headless endpoint checks as proof of readable owner/route/contact semantics.

requiredVerification: No browser work performed. If coordinator retains the candidate despite the spatial verdict, verify the intermediate probe motion defect, visible copies/contacts, keyboard actions, stale results, Reset and reduced motion at 420px and desktop.
